title.narrative: UNICEF supported National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM) institutions in UNICEF-supported states with strengthened women's engagement and family dialogue on priority nutrition behaviours through 92.04 million Se;f Help Groups mobilizing 115 million members under the Food, Nutrition, Health, and WASH (FNHW) programme. UNICEF contributed to strengthening community level nutrition systems by leveraging decentralized communication platforms and civil society networks. Through the use of 200 community radio stations for localized nutrition messaging during Poshan Maah and the engagement of 600 CSOs and academic partners through the Poshan Ghar network, UNICEF reinforced mechanisms for civic participation, social mobilization, and collective action to support improved nutrition outcomes.

204.5% of UNICEF-supported states that are implementing evidence-based inclusive gender SBC plans linked to Poshan 2.0 and RMNCAH+N (healthy diets across life cycle, IYCN, ECD, maternal and adolescent nutrition) ensuring participation of men and boys , Percent

204.6% of UNICEF-supported states capacitated to implement SBC strategies and approaches through strengthened convergent community engagement and coordination mechanisms to promote priority nutrition behaviours (healthy diets across life cycle) amongst vulnerable group, Percent
